comment: The active knob set is not chosen here: button_expander.cc:26-36 copies it from the Hub when the module is made, and hub_module.hh:370-380 changes it on every button expander in the patch when the Hub's knob set changes. The panel's index label is a plain widget, not a parameter, so no help line can be reached by clicking it; the same setting is on the menu as Address.
